jamie.docs: Quick check 1: I noticed the 'first deploy' snippet in the hello-quickstart uses `await client.generate()` but the SDK method is now `createCompletion`. Could we align examples?
nina.devex: Good catch. That's likely from a legacy copy-paste. We should update both JS and Python quickstart pages.
sam.eng: Happy to PR. Suggest we keep a small compatibility note: "If you upgraded from SDK <2.0, rename generate -> createCompletion" and add a one-line migration example.
jamie.docs: Yes, and also please update the inline code comment that shows the response shape; `result.text` is now `result.output[0].text`.
sam.eng: Will do: 1) change method name, 2) fix response access, 3) run docsite build locally. PR incoming in ~20m.
merge-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 "docs(quickstart): update SDK method and response access" by sam.eng
nina.devex: After CI pass, I'll tweak the tutorial wording to keep it minimal for newbies.
jamie.docs: Thanks — also make sure the Playgrounds/Copy button still works after the snippet change.
merge-bot: CI: docs build passed. Ready to merge.
sam.eng: Merged. I'll follow up with a backport to older example repos.
